final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.region_name, AVG(dc.client_count) AS average_count, AVG(1.0 * dc.client_count / t.total_count) AS average_share FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dc.region_name ORDER BY dc.region_name
